project_title: Fizik SPM Hub - Premium UI Assets
global_style: Ultra-premium executive physics education platform. Liquid Glass / Aurora UI aesthetic. Deep Violet #5E17EB primary, Accent Yellow #FFD600 secondary. Clean geometric layout, subtle gradient meshes, photorealistic 3D spheres with volumetric lighting, translucent glass morphism cards. Zero decorative text, zero mottos, zero taglines. Transparent PNG output only.
negative_constraints: STRICTLY NO quotes, mottos, taglines, inspirational text, decorative filler text, watermarks, signatures, UI chrome, browser windows, shadows on transparent background, grey backgrounds. ONLY the isolated asset object on pure transparency.

pages.title: Hero 3D Physics Composition - Premium Transparent
pages.prompt: Ultra-premium 3D physics education hero composition for transparent PNG export. Centered floating stack: 1) Top - realistic A4 exam paper sheet with subtle printed physics formulas (E=mc², F=ma, λ=h/p) in Deep Violet #5E17EB ink, slight paper curl at corners, soft ambient occlusion. 2) Middle - semi-transparent crystalline glass sphere refracting light, containing miniature wave propagation visualization (sinusoidal waves in violet/yellow), with lensing caustics. 3) Bottom - hexagonal graphene/honeycomb lattice platform in metallic slate, catching subtle rim lighting. Overall lighting: Three-point studio setup with key light from top-left (cool white), fill from right (warm), rim from back (violet accent #5E17EB). Subtle volumetric fog. Color palette: Deep Violet #5E17EB, Accent Yellow #FFD600, Slate #0F172A, Pearl White #FAFAF9. Render style: Photorealistic Octane/Redshift quality, 8K detail, clean alpha channel for transparent background. NO TEXT, NO LABELS, NO UI ELEMENTS, NO SHADOWS ON BACKGROUND - pure isolated floating composition with alpha transparency.

Surface: subtle iridescent pearl coating catching light. Floating white line-icon inside: 'file-plus-2' (document with plus sign), crisp vector style, white with subtle drop shadow. Top badge: Number '1' in white, set in crimson circular badge with white stroke, floating slightly above sphere. Lighting: Hero key light creating specular highlight at 35% 30%, volumetric bloom/glow extending beyond sphere boundary (crimson ambient #DC2626 at 45% opacity). NO SHADOWS CAST ON BACKGROUND - pure transparency with glow bleed. 8K photorealistic render, clean alpha.

pages.title: Corner Arc Accent - Premium Gradient Transparent
pages.prompt: Premium decorative corner arc accent for bottom-left page corner, transparent PNG. Elegant sweeping quarter-circle arc (90 degree curve) with premium gradient stroke: starts Deep Violet #5E17EB at outer edge, flows through Accent Yellow #FFD600 at mid-curve, ends in Crimson #DC2626 at inner edge. Stroke weight: elegant 3pt tapering to 1.5pt at ends. Subtle glow bloom along curve (violet 30% opacity). Optional: 3-4 tiny floating particles/sparkles along curve in yellow/white. NO FILL, NO BACKGROUND, NO TEXT - pure transparent stroke curve only. Vector-clean edges, 8K resolution.

pages.title: Premium Gradient Mesh Background - Subtle Hero
pages.prompt: Ultra-subtle premium gradient mesh background for hero section, transparent PNG (subtle overlay). Large soft radial gradient blobs: 1) Top-left: Deep Violet #5E17EB at 4% opacity, 600px radius. 2) Center-right: Accent Yellow #FFD600 at 3% opacity, 500px radius. 3) Bottom-center: Crimson #DC2626 at 2% opacity, 400px radius. Blend mode: Screen/Overlay simulation. NO HARD EDGES, NO VISIBLE SHAPES - only ethereal color atmosphere. Pure transparency with colored light bleed. For use as CSS background-image overlay. 4K.

pages.title: Premium Glass Morphism Card Texture - Transparent
pages.prompt: Premium glass morphism card surface texture for UI cards, transparent PNG tileable. Subtle frosted glass effect: fine Gaussian noise texture (0.5% opacity), barely visible horizontal lens flares (2px height, 8% opacity white), micro-scratches catching light. Edge highlight: 1px white stroke at top-left edges (15% opacity). Color tint: barely perceptible Violet #5E17EB at 2% opacity. Designed for CSS backdrop-filter: blur(20px) + this texture overlay. NO VISIBLE UI CONTENT, NO TEXT - pure transparent glass surface texture. 2K tileable.

pages.title: Logo Atom - Premium 3D Transparent
pages.prompt: Ultra-premium 3D atom logo for Fizik SPM Hub, transparent PNG. Central nucleus: dual-proton-neutron cluster in metallic slate #1E293B with subtle gold rim. Three orbital rings at 60-degree offsets: Ring 1 (horizontal) - Violet #5E17EB glowing electron trail. Ring 2 (45 deg) - Yellow #FFD600 glowing electron trail. Ring 3 (vertical) - Crimson #DC2626 glowing electron trail. Electrons: small bright spheres with volumetric glow trails. Overall: Clean Apple-style product render, studio lighting, subtle floor reflection (fades to transparency). NO TEXT, NO LABELS. Clean alpha channel. 4K.
